info.name: Temenos Transact Core Banking Accounts API

params.name: accountType
params.description: Filter by account type (e.g., CURRENT, SAVINGS, CORPORATE)

items.docs: Retrieve a list of customer accounts. Supports filtering by customer, account type, status, currency, and other criteria. Returns account arrangements created through the Arrangement Architecture including current, savings, corporate, and Islamic account types.
